commands.label: Open Vault…
commands.hint: Show the open-folder picker.

commands.label: Close Vault
commands.hint: Close the current vault and return to the welcome screen.

commands.label: Quick Open…
commands.hint: Fuzzy-find a note by name and open it. Return opens it in the current tab.

commands.label: Jump to Bibliography
commands.hint: Filter the Bibliography sidebar to the expanded citation's key.

commands.label: Duplicate Tab
commands.hint: Duplicate the current note into a new tab.

commands.label: Close Tab
commands.hint: Close the active tab. Prompts if it has unsaved changes.

commands.label: Reopen Closed Tab
commands.hint: Reopen the most recently closed tab. Files that no longer exist are skipped.

commands.label: Show Next Tab
commands.hint: Activate the tab to the right, wrapping at the end.

commands.label: Show Previous Tab
commands.hint: Activate the tab to the left, wrapping at the start.

commands.label: Move Tab Left
commands.hint: Reorder the active tab one position left.
commands.divergence: G18: the rule maps ⌃⌘← to Ctrl+Alt+Left, which focusPaneLeft (⌥⌘←) already owns. Shift disambiguates. Shipped in W1-3; recorded, not rebound.

commands.label: Move Tab Right
commands.hint: Reorder the active tab one position right.
commands.divergence: G18: the rule maps ⌃⌘→ to Ctrl+Alt+Right, which focusPaneRight (⌥⌘→) already owns. Shift disambiguates. Shipped in W1-3; recorded, not rebound.

commands.label: Split Right
commands.hint: Split the focused pane side-by-side; the new pane shows the same note.

commands.label: Split Down
commands.hint: Split the focused pane top-and-bottom; the new pane shows the same note.

commands.label: Focus Pane Left
commands.hint: Move focus to the pane to the left.

commands.label: Focus Pane Right
commands.hint: Move focus to the pane to the right.

commands.label: Focus Pane Above
commands.hint: Move focus to the pane above.

commands.label: Focus Pane Below
commands.hint: Move focus to the pane below.

commands.label: Grow Pane
commands.hint: Make the focused pane larger.

commands.label: Shrink Pane
commands.hint: Make the focused pane smaller.

commands.label: Close Pane
commands.hint: Close the focused pane's tabs, prompting for unsaved changes.

commands.label: Open Selected File in New Tab
commands.hint: Open the sidebar's selected file in a new tab.

commands.label: Open Selected File in Split
commands.hint: Open the sidebar's selected file in a new split pane.

commands.label: Toggle Right Pane
commands.hint: Hide or show the right pane (the panel rail). Control-Alt-I.

commands.label: Search Vault
commands.hint: Toggle the vault-wide search overlay.

commands.label: Show History Panel
commands.hint: Open the History leaf in the right pane.

commands.label: Refresh Sync Diagnostics
commands.hint: Re-run sync-system detection and reload the LiveSync config.

commands.label: Focus Next Pane
commands.hint: Move focus to the next pane in layout order, wrapping at the end.

commands.label: Focus Previous Pane
commands.hint: Move focus to the previous pane in layout order, wrapping at the start.

commands.label: Save
commands.hint: Save the current note to disk.

commands.label: Toggle Reading Mode
commands.hint: Switch the current note between editing and reading mode.

commands.label: Citation Summary
commands.hint: Open the citation summary for the current note.

commands.label: Add Property…
commands.hint: Add a new frontmatter property to the current note.

commands.label: Bulk Rename Properties…
commands.hint: Open the bulk-rename sheet to rename a property across the vault.

commands.label: Editor: Zoom In
commands.hint: Increase the editing surfaces' text size one step.

commands.label: Editor: Zoom Out
commands.hint: Decrease the editing surfaces' text size one step.

commands.label: Editor: Actual Size
commands.hint: Reset the editing surfaces' text size to 100 percent.

commands.label: Check Spelling While Typing
commands.hint: Toggle live spell checking in the note editor. Off by default for Markdown source.

commands.label: Activate at Cursor
commands.hint: Activate the link, tag, citation, embed, or task under the cursor.

commands.label: Preview Embed
commands.hint: Open the embed under the cursor in the interaction popover.

commands.label: Open Reading Links in New Tab
commands.hint: Choose whether activating a reading-mode link opens a new tab or reuses the current one.

commands.label: Show Changes Since Last Open
commands.hint: Show what changed in a note since it was last opened. Takes effect at the next note activation.

commands.label: Reload Bibliography
commands.hint: Re-read the vault's bibliography sources after fixing them.

commands.label: Tasks Review
commands.hint: Open the vault-wide Tasks Review leaf in the right pane.

commands.label: Bases: Open View Switcher
commands.hint: List the views in the active base.

commands.label: Bases: Next View
commands.hint: Switch to the next view in the active base.

commands.label: Bases: Previous View
commands.hint: Switch to the previous view in the active base.

commands.label: Bases: Sort by Column
commands.hint: Sort the active base table from the focused column.

commands.label: Bases: Save Sort to View
commands.hint: Persist the current base table sort to the active view.

commands.label: Bases: View as Table
commands.hint: Temporarily render the active base with table cell navigation.

commands.label: Bases: View as List
commands.hint: Temporarily render the active base with row navigation.

commands.label: Bases: Quick Filter
commands.hint: Focus the active base's temporary quick filter field.

commands.label: Bases: Where Am I?
commands.hint: Read the active base, view, and temporary quick filter.

commands.label: Bases: Open Row
commands.hint: Open the selected base result row.

commands.label: Bases: Copy Link
commands.hint: Copy a wikilink to the selected base result row.

commands.label: Bases: Show Backlinks
commands.hint: Show backlinks for the selected base result row.

commands.label: Bases: Edit Property
commands.hint: Edit the selected editable base property cell.

commands.label: Bases: Export View as CSV
commands.hint: Export the active base view as CSV.

commands.label: Bases: Export View as Markdown Table
commands.hint: Export the active base view as a Markdown table.

commands.label: Bases: Copy View as Markdown
commands.hint: Copy the active base view as a Markdown table.

commands.label: Bases: Results
commands.hint: Read the result count and summary for the active base.

commands.label: Bases: Refresh
commands.hint: Reload the active base and re-run its current view.

commands.label: Bases: New Query
commands.hint: Open the structured Bases query builder.

commands.label: Bases: Edit View Filters
commands.hint: Open the active base view in the structured query builder.

commands.label: Bases: Add Condition
commands.reason: PR-4: overlay-scoped interaction of an already-open surface (the arrow-keys-in-a-list rule), not an app command. The Windows builder sheet owns the row verbs.

commands.label: Bases: Add Group
commands.reason: PR-4: overlay-scoped interaction of an already-open surface (the arrow-keys-in-a-list rule), not an app command. The Windows builder sheet owns the row verbs.

commands.reason: PR-4: overlay-scoped interaction of an already-open surface (the arrow-keys-in-a-list rule), not an app command. The Windows builder sheet owns the row verbs.

commands.label: Canvas: Show Outline
commands.hint: Show the canvas as an outline of its cards, groups and connections.

commands.label: Canvas: Show Table
commands.hint: Show the canvas as a sortable table of its cards.

commands.label: Canvas: Show Visual
commands.hint: Show the canvas as its spatial board.

commands.label: Canvas: Where Am I?
commands.hint: Read the selected card's full context: position, group, connections, color, and marks. Also rendered in a panel you can read at leisure.
commands.divergence: D-2: the rule predicts Ctrl+Alt+I, which slate.view.toggleRightPane holds at Global scope — live at the same moment as a focused canvas, so this is a collision and not a disjoint pair. Disambiguated with Shift per the G18 precedent.

commands.label: Canvas: Next Card
commands.hint: Select the next card in reading order.

commands.label: Canvas: Previous Card
commands.hint: Select the previous card in reading order.

commands.label: Canvas: Enter Group
commands.hint: Move into the selected group's first card.

commands.label: Canvas: Exit Group
commands.hint: Move out to the containing group.

commands.label: Canvas: Follow Connection Forward
commands.hint: Jump along the selected card's first outgoing connection.

commands.label: Canvas: Follow Connection Back
commands.hint: Jump along the selected card's first incoming connection.

commands.label: Canvas: Trace Path from Selected Card
commands.hint: Walk the outgoing chain, announcing each hop and the visited count.

commands.label: Canvas: Zoom In
commands.hint: Zoom the visual board in one step.

commands.label: Canvas: Zoom Out
commands.hint: Zoom the visual board out one step.

commands.label: Canvas: Actual Size
commands.hint: Zoom the visual board to 100 percent.

commands.label: Canvas: Fit Canvas
commands.hint: Fit every card in the visual board's view.

commands.label: Canvas: Zoom to Selection
commands.hint: Fill the visual board's view with the selected cards.

commands.label: Canvas: Connect To…
commands.hint: Draw a connection from the selected card to a card you pick, with an optional label.

commands.label: Canvas: Toggle Mark
commands.hint: Mark or unmark the selected card. Bulk actions apply to every marked card at once.

commands.label: Canvas: Show Marked Cards
commands.hint: Open the marks list: jump to or unmark any marked card.

commands.label: Canvas: Group Marked Cards…
commands.hint: Wrap the marked cards in a new labeled group - one action, one undo.

commands.label: Canvas: Delete Marked Cards
commands.hint: Delete every marked card and its connections - one summary, one undo.

commands.label: Canvas: Color Marked Cards…
commands.hint: Set every marked card's color at once - one action, one undo.

commands.label: Canvas: Clear All Marks
commands.hint: Unmark every marked card.

commands.label: Canvas: Delete Selection
commands.hint: Delete the selected card, or ungroup the selected group keeping its cards. Undo with Ctrl+Z.

commands.label: Canvas: Edit Card Text…
commands.hint: Open the selected text card in the editor. Escape saves and returns.

commands.label: Canvas: Rename Group…
commands.hint: Rename the selected group — group labels are the skeleton of the reading order.

commands.label: Canvas: Set Color…
commands.hint: Color the selected card by name: red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, or purple.

commands.label: Canvas: Clear Color
commands.hint: Remove the selected card's color.

commands.label: Canvas: New Group…
commands.hint: Create a labeled group next to the selection.

commands.label: Canvas: Add Link Card…
commands.hint: Paste or type a URL; a link card is placed next to your selection.

commands.label: Canvas: Move into Group…
commands.hint: Move the selected card inside a group by name — no dragging or coordinates.

commands.label: Canvas: Edit Connection…
commands.hint: Change one of the selected card's connection labels or direction.

commands.label: Canvas: Delete Connection…
commands.hint: Delete one of the selected card's connections. Undo with Ctrl+Z.

commands.label: Canvas: Add Note to Canvas…
commands.hint: Pick a vault note; a file card is placed next to your selection.

commands.label: Canvas: Add Media…
commands.hint: Pick a vault media file; a file card is placed next to your selection.

commands.label: Canvas: Locate File…
commands.hint: Repoint the selected file card at a different vault file.

commands.label: Canvas: Remove from Group
commands.hint: Move the selected card out of its enclosing group, placed by the engine.

commands.label: Canvas: Create Connected Card
commands.hint: New text card below the selection, already connected, ready to type.
commands.divergence: mac's ⌃⌥⌘N; the modifier rule maps it onto Ctrl+Alt+N, which New Card owns (mac's ⌥⌘N), so Shift disambiguates — the spec's §7 allocation, free on Windows.

commands.label: Canvas: Create Connected Card (Choose Direction)…
commands.hint: Pick the side first, then the connected card is created there.

commands.label: Canvas: Duplicate
commands.hint: Duplicate the selected card or the marked set — one action, one undo.

commands.label: Canvas: Convert Card to Note…
commands.hint: Create a vault note from the text card; the card then points at it.

commands.label: Canvas: Connect Mode
commands.hint: Remember the selected card, navigate to a target with the usual movements, press Return to connect.

commands.label: Canvas: Place Below…
commands.hint: Move the selected card (or the marked set) just below a card you pick.

commands.label: Canvas: Place Right Of…
commands.hint: Move the selection just right of a card you pick.

commands.label: Canvas: Place Above…
commands.hint: Move the selection just above a card you pick.

commands.label: Canvas: Place Left Of…
commands.hint: Move the selection just left of a card you pick.

commands.label: Canvas: Align With…
commands.hint: Align the selected card's top edge with a card you pick. Overlaps are refused, never silent.

commands.label: Canvas: Move Mode
commands.hint: Grab the selection. Arrows nudge on the grid, Shift for big steps, Return places, Escape cancels.

commands.label: Canvas: Resize Mode
commands.hint: Resize the selected card. Left and Right change width, Up and Down change height.

commands.label: Canvas: Resize to Default Size
commands.hint: Set the card being resized back to the default card size.

commands.label: Canvas: Resize to Fit Content
commands.hint: Size the card being resized to its text.

commands.label: Canvas: New Card
commands.hint: Create a text card next to the selection - placement is automatic and announced.

commands.label: Canvas: Filter Cards…
commands.hint: Focus the filter field (Ctrl+F on a canvas): narrows by title, type, group, or target.

commands.label: Canvas: Clear Filter
commands.hint: Show every card again (also the Escape rung while filtering).

commands.label: Canvas: Commit Mode
commands.hint: Apply the active move or resize (same as Enter).

commands.label: Canvas: Cancel Mode
commands.hint: Cancel the active move or resize and restore the prior position (same as Escape).

commands.label: Canvas: Toggle Viewport Follows Selection
commands.hint: When on (the default), the visual view pans to keep the selection visible.

commands.label: Open
commands.hint: Open the selected files.

commands.label: New Note
commands.hint: Create an untitled note in the selected location, then rename it.
commands.divergence: Windows binds no chord: the verb is menu- and palette-only here. Recorded so the mac chord stays visible rather than reading as an absence.

commands.label: New Folder
commands.hint: Create a new folder in the selected location, then rename it.

commands.label: New Note from Template…
commands.hint: Choose a template for a new note.

commands.label: New Canvas
commands.hint: Create an empty canvas file in the vault and open it.

commands.label: Import Files and Folders…
commands.hint: Choose files and folders. External items are copied into the selected location; items already in this vault are moved.

commands.label: Cancel Import
commands.hint: Stops remaining imports. Completed copies remain in the vault.
commands.divergence: The rule maps ⌘. to Ctrl+. ; Windows cancels with Escape. Escape is the Windows cancellation convention and stays scoped to the running import (PR-2: overlay dismissal keeps precedence outside import).

commands.label: Rename…
commands.hint: Rename the selected file or folder in place.
commands.divergence: The rule maps ⌥⌘R to Ctrl+Alt+R; Windows uses F2, the platform rename convention shared by Explorer, list views, and grids (decision 12: platform convention governs input).

commands.label: Move To…
commands.hint: Move the selected files or folders to another folder.
commands.divergence: Windows binds no chord: the verb is menu- and palette-only here. Recorded so the mac chord stays visible rather than reading as an absence.

commands.label: Move to Trash
commands.hint: Move the selected files or folders to the Recycle Bin.

commands.label: Duplicate
commands.hint: Duplicate the selected file as a copy next to it.

commands.label: Copy Path
commands.hint: Copy the selected item's path.

commands.label: Reveal in File Explorer
commands.hint: Show the selected file or folder in File Explorer.
commands.labelDivergence: FD-5: mac's label is "Reveal in Finder" — Finder does not exist on Windows, and the platform surface it names does. The id stays shared (the capability is the same verb); the label follows the OS. Recorded, never relabeled.

commands.label: Copy Wikilink
commands.hint: Copy a wikilink to the selected Markdown file.

commands.label: Pin to Top of Folder
commands.hint: Pin the selected note to the top of its folder.

commands.label: Unpin
commands.hint: Remove the selected note from its folder's pinned section.

commands.label: Unpin All in Folder
commands.hint: Remove every pinned note from the selected folder.

commands.label: Use Vault Default Sort
commands.hint: Remove the selected folder's sort override.

commands.label: Add to Shortcuts
commands.hint: Add the selected file or folder to the Shortcuts section.

commands.label: Remove from Shortcuts
commands.hint: Remove the selected file or folder from the Shortcuts section.

commands.label: Clear Recents
commands.hint: Clear the shared recent-files history for this vault.

commands.label: Collapse All Folders
commands.hint: Collapse every folder except the current selection's ancestors.

commands.label: Expand Loaded Folders
commands.hint: Expand already-loaded folders, fetching at most one level deeper.

commands.label: Back in Sidebar History
commands.hint: Select the previous sidebar selection from this window's history.

commands.label: Forward in Sidebar History
commands.hint: Select the next sidebar selection from this window's history.

commands.label: Clear Sidebar Filter

commands.label: Toggle Tag Column

commands.label: Move Checked Items to the Recycle Bin
commands.hint: Move every batch-checked item to the Recycle Bin.

chordSurface.label: Property row editor verbs
chordSurface.reason: PR-4: the eleven PropertyRowViewModel commands (commit, revert, delete, step up/down, add item, toggle boolean, remove item, and the three list-row pass-throughs) are row actions — they need a row context the palette cannot supply. Mac draws the same line for History's Compare/Restore.

chordSurface.label: AccessibleDataGrid routed commands
chordSurface.reason: PR-4: the four static RoutedCommands (export CSV, export Markdown, toggle sort, filter) are the grid substrate's, scoped to a focused grid. The app-level capabilities are the registered slate.bases.* ids.

chordSurface.label: Canvas mode: large step down
chordSurface.reason: §F TF-3 (FD-3): the large grid step while a move or resize transient holds the arrows; without a mode the chord is unbound and typing keeps Shift+arrows.

chordSurface.label: Files tree: undo the last structural operation
chordSurface.reason: W5-4 (F10): tree-scoped structural undo — renames and moves re-run their inverse through the forward FFI; batch moves ride UndoBatchMove. Live only while the files tree owns focus; the editor keeps Ctrl+Z everywhere else (FD-1).

chordSurface.label: Files tree: redo the last undone structural operation
chordSurface.divergence: The rule maps ⇧⌘Z to Ctrl+Shift+Z, but Ctrl+Y is the platform redo convention (Notepad, Office, Explorer's rename field). Recorded as the deliberate Windows binding — W5-4 decision 12.
chordSurface.reason: W5-4 (F10): tree-scoped structural redo. mac uses ⇧⌘Z; Ctrl+Y is the Windows redo convention (decision 12).

chordSurface.label: Files tree: move the selection to the Recycle Bin
chordSurface.divergence: The rule maps ⌘⌫ to Ctrl+Backspace, but the bare Delete key is the platform deletion convention (Explorer, list views). Recorded as the deliberate Windows binding — W5-4 decision 12 / FD-4.
chordSurface.reason: W5-4 (F6, FD-4): tree-scoped Delete riding the same imperative MainWindow delivery as F2-rename — the selection verb, with Finder-parity confirmation staging. mac scopes ⌘⌫ to its file tree identically.
